title: Taxonomizing Representational Harms using Speech Act Theory

bias_targets.methodology: Developing a theoretical framework grounded in speech act theory to conceptualize and taxonomize system behaviors (illocutionary acts) that cause stereotyping, demeaning, and erasure across various broadly experienced social hierarchies.

Qualitative analysis of illustrative generative language outputs (e.g., sourced from the ToxiGen dataset) targeting LGBTQ+ individuals to demonstrate how the proposed speech act taxonomy classifies stereotyping, demeaning, and erasing behaviors.

Critiquing the FairPrism dataset's annotation guidelines and specific example utterances regarding women to evaluate how current measurement instruments operationalize and handle definitions of stereotyping and demeaning language.
